name: CER science writing feedback dataset (Playlab)
summary: A planned de-identified dataset of 2,000 to 3,000 multi-turn AI feedback conversations on students' claim, evidence and reasoning writing in science, with an annotation rubric.

license.note: Stated intent: the dataset under CC BY 4.0 and the de-identification and preparation scripts under Apache 2.0; no license is named for the rubric.

cite: Playlab. Building a Proof-of-Concept Dataset for AI-Enabled Formative Writing Feedback in Science: Validating Critical Thinking Through Claims, Evidence, and Reasoning. K-12 AI Infrastructure Program project, https://k12-ai-infrastructure.org/playlab/
expected: The project page gives no date; the Program expects its new public goods to be released in summer 2027.

fits.how: Its rubric could rate feedback replies on science writing in agent tests, checked against its annotations.

connect.note: Not released yet, so there is nothing to fetch or check.
